meta.title: Procrastination Test
meta.description: A detailed 500-question reflection across 20 dimensions of procrastination.

levels.label: Very High Procrastination Pattern
levels.desc: Delay appears frequent, wide-ranging, and disruptive across several mechanisms. Focused support and a small structured starting plan may be valuable.

levels.label: High Procrastination Pattern
levels.desc: You report substantial delay habits involving initiation, discomfort, distraction, or deadline dependence across many situations.

levels.label: Moderate Procrastination Pattern
levels.desc: Procrastination affects a meaningful set of situations, alongside some useful action and recovery skills.

levels.label: Situational Procrastination
levels.desc: Delay occurs in particular contexts or task types, but it does not appear equally strong across every dimension.

levels.label: Low Procrastination Pattern
levels.desc: You report relatively few persistent delay habits and generally use constructive ways to begin or resume work.

levels.label: Very Low Procrastination Pattern
levels.desc: Your responses suggest timely initiation, limited avoidance, and strong recovery habits across most situations.
